description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 17.04.2023 to 23.04.2023
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and specifically deals with setting new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges. It contains regulatory content about how customs calculations should be performed, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than government personnel/structure, land, commercial, or other specialized categories.
